declarations.description:
Draws arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps, blur and redaction over an image, then exports a PNG and the shapes:
the markup step of a bug report, a support ticket or a design review.

Pick a tool from the toolbar and drag on the image (click for text and numbers); Shift keeps lines at 45° steps and
boxes square. `select` moves and resizes shapes by their handles. Colours come from `colors`, and three stroke
widths are offered. Undo and redo are buttons, and Ctrl/⌘+Z and Shift+Ctrl/⌘+Z.

Shapes are plain objects in the image's own pixels (`shapes`, JSON as an attribute), so they stay in place at any
display size; `annotation-change` gives them after every edit. `toBlob()` and `toDataURL()` draw the image at its
natural size with the shapes. Redactions are drawn above every other shape. In the export, a redaction replaces the
pixels and a blur is a coarse pixelation, so
text under either cannot be recovered; use redaction for secrets. An image from another origin needs CORS
(`crossorigin`) to be exported: otherwise the export rejects and `annotator-error` says why.

Every tool works from the keyboard: with a drawing tool chosen, Enter on the image adds a shape in the middle; with
`select`, Tab reaches each shape, the arrow keys nudge it (Shift for 10 px) and Delete removes it. `readonly` shows
the shapes with no toolbar.

`active` is the chosen shape, the same one `select` picks: highlighted, scrolled into view when it changes, and
reported by `shape-select` whenever the person (or `next()`/`previous()`) changes it. Beside it the `detail` slot,
or `renderDetail`, shows the app's card for that shape: a comment thread on a pin, the field of an extracted region.
With `readonly selectable`, shapes are still chosen by click, Tab and the arrow keys, but not edited: the review
mode of OCR extraction or of a pinned plan. A shape's `label` names it, and a `confidence` under
`confidence-threshold` flags it for review.
declarations.name: ImageAnnotator

cssProperties.description: Behind the image, seen through transparent pixels.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__stage--background-color

cssProperties.description: The selected shape's outline and handles.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__selection--color

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the resize handles on a selected box.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__handle--size

cssProperties.description: Text shapes, on screen and in the export.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__text--font-family

cssProperties.description: The digit in a number badge.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__number--color

cssProperties.description: The other shapes while one is active; lower it to spotlight the active one.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__shape__inactive--opacity

cssProperties.description: The outline of a box, ellipse, line, arrow or drawing whose `confidence` is under `confidence-threshold`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__low-confidence--color

cssProperties.description: The dash of a low-confidence outline, in image pixels.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__low-confidence--stroke-dasharray

cssProperties.description: The card's width, never wider than the room beside its shape.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__detail--width

cssProperties.description: The gap between the card and its shape.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__detail--offset

cssParts.description: The card container beside the active shape, wrapping the `detail` slot; with nothing assigned, it holds what `renderDetail` draws as the slot's fallback.
cssParts.name: detail

slots.description: The app's card for the active shape (a comment thread, an extracted field), shown beside it. Replaces what `renderDetail` draws.
slots.name: detail

members.name: src
members.description: The image to annotate.

members.name: crossorigin
members.description: Passed to the image; `anonymous` lets an image from another origin with CORS be exported.

members.name: shapes
members.description: The shapes, in image pixels.

members.name: tool
members.description: The tool in use.

members.name: colors
members.description: The colours offered; the first is chosen to start.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the shapes with no toolbar and no editing.

members.name: alt
members.description: The image's accessible description, read before its shapes.

members.name: active
members.description:
The id of the chosen shape: highlighted, scrolled into view when it changes, with the `detail` card beside it. It
is the selection of the `select` tool, so choosing a shape sets it; set it from the app to follow a focused form
field.

members.name: selectable
members.description: With `readonly`, shapes can still be chosen (click, Tab, the arrow keys) and report `shape-select`.

members.name: confidenceThreshold
members.description: A shape whose `confidence` is under this value (0 to 1) is flagged for review.

members.name: renderDetail
members.description: Draws the card beside the active shape when the `detail` slot is empty.

members.name: editOrigin
members.description: The shapes before the text being edited was added or changed: the edit commits against them.

members.name: chosen
members.description: The id the person last chose (a click, Tab): that `active` is not scrolled into view; one the app sets is.

members.name: ready
members.description: The first render is done: an `active` the page loads with does not scroll the page.

type.text: { kind: 'draw' | 'move' | 'handle'; startX: number; startY: number; origin: AnnotatorShape; handle?: number; moved: boolean } | null

members.name: clearHistory
members.description: Clears the history, so a new image starts with nothing to undo.

members.name: next
members.description: Makes the shape after the active one active (the first when none is), reports it and scrolls it into view.

members.name: previous
members.description: Makes the shape before the active one active (the last when none is), reports it and scrolls it into view.

members.name: toCanvas
members.description: The image at its natural size with the shapes drawn on it, redactions and blurs flattened into the pixels.

members.name: toBlob
members.description: The annotated image as a `Blob`; `image/png` unless another type is given.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description: The annotated image as a data URL.

members.name: paint
members.description: Draws one shape onto the export canvas, the same geometry as the SVG.

members.name: layered
members.description: The shapes in drawing order: as drawn, with every redaction on top.

members.name: choose
members.description: Changes the active shape from inside: reported by `shape-select`, and scrolled into view only when `reveal`.

members.name: edit
members.description: Starts editing a text shape.

members.name: point
members.description: A pointer position in image pixels.

members.name: resized
members.description: The shape after dragging handle `handle` to (`x`, `y`): the two ends of a line, else the four corners.

members.name: step
members.description: Undo or redo from the toolbar; when that empties its stack the button turns off, so focus moves to the image.

members.name: onReviewKey
members.description: Review mode: the arrow keys walk the shapes, Enter opens the card, Escape clears the choice.

members.name: openDetail
members.description: Moves the keyboard into the card beside the active shape, when there is one.

members.name: pickable
members.description: Whether shapes can be chosen: the `select` tool, or `readonly selectable`.

members.name: finishText
members.description: Ends the text edit with `value` (the editor's text when left out): one history entry, or none if nothing changed.

members.name: shapeName
members.description: "Rectangle 2 of 5: Invoice total: 62% confidence", for assistive technology.

members.name: renderCard
members.description: The card beside the active shape: the `detail` slot, else what `renderDetail` draws; hidden when neither has content.

events.name: annotator-error
events.description: An export failed, for example on a cross-origin image without CORS.

events.name: shape-select
events.description: The active shape changed by click, keyboard, drawing, deleting, `next()` or `previous()`; not when `active` is set. Does not bubble.

events.name: annotation-change
events.description: The shapes changed: drawn, moved, resized, edited, deleted, undone or redone.
